lines.hook: What if the internet just... died? | Everywhere. | For a whole week.
lines.goal: And trust me, day seven is the wildest part.
lines.day1: Day one. | You wake up, grab your phone... | nothing. No messages. No maps. Your bank app? | Just spinning.
lines.cash: You go to pay for coffee. | Declined. | Cash only. | And be honest, when did you last carry cash?
lines.day2: Day two. | Offices give up and send everyone home. Flights? | Grounded. | And that's not made up. In 2024, one bad update cancelled thousands of flights.
lines.day3: Day three. | The shelves start emptying. Because the trucks run on apps.
lines.twist: But here's the crazy part. | Your GPS still works. That's satellites, not the internet. Radio? | Works. A normal phone call? | Might actually go through.
lines.day5: Day five. | People do something wild. | They knock on their neighbors' doors. | And talk.
lines.cost: Meanwhile, every single day costs the world around forty-three billion dollars.
lines.real: So could this really happen? | Honestly? | Almost impossible. The internet is hundreds of cables under the ocean. Cut one, | and the data just goes around it.
lines.day7: And day seven? | It all comes back. | Every. Single. Notification. | At once.
lines.cta: So be honest... | how long would you last?
